inputs.text: Cuba seems to be heading toward some sort of political transition. Some Cubans are worried that the residents own nothing and are too impoverished to take over the few functioning businesses on the island, while a large and wealthy diaspora community, and potentially foreign investors as well, would be able to swoop in and purchase property and businesses at bargain prices.
